standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the uniqueness of alpha_0, ..., alpha_r with alpha_0 = alpha satisfying the displayed relation, by identifying the Chow group of the projective bundle with the direct sum of the Chow groups of the base.

standard_prerequisites.name: Flat pullback versus proper pushforward, and the projection formula
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter chow.tex, labels lemma-flat-pullback-proper-pushforward (proof line 7348) and lemma-pushforward-cap-c1 (proof line 7349)
standard_prerequisites.use: Allows the relation proved on the disjoint union of the projective bundles over the components to be transported back to P, and then to the relation with pi^*(p_* beta_j) on X.

core_obligations: Observe that the identity alpha_0 = alpha together with the displayed relation determines the classes alpha_j uniquely, because the projective space bundle formula identifies the relevant part of the Chow group of P with the direct sum of the Chow groups of X, and note that the identity is true by definition when alpha = [W] for an integral closed subscheme W (proof lines 7298-7305).

For a general cycle alpha = sum n_a [W_a], form the disjoint union X' of the W_a with its proper morphism p : X' -> X and the induced projective bundle P' = product of the P_a over X', observing that O_{P'}(1) is simultaneously the product of the O_{P_a}(1) and the pullback of O_P(1), and deduce the relation on P' for beta_j = sum n_a beta_{a,j} from the individual relations beta_{a,j} = c_j(E|_{W_a}) cap [W_a] (proof lines 7306-7345).

Push the relation down along p' : P' -> P: the identity pi^* p_* beta_j = p'_* (pi')^* beta_j together with the projection formula turns the relation on P' into the displayed relation on P with alpha_j replaced by p_* beta_j, and since p_* beta_j is a representative of c_j(E) cap alpha the characterisation is proved (proof lines 7346-7356).
proof_roadmap: Get uniqueness from the projective space bundle formula and handle a single integral class (proof lines 7298-7305).
Move to the disjoint union of the components and prove the relation there (proof lines 7306-7345).
Transport the relation back along the proper morphism using the projection formula (proof lines 7346-7356).
difficulty_reason: The lemma characterises the Chow classes c_j(E) cap alpha of a finite locally free sheaf of rank r on X as the unique classes alpha_j with alpha_0 = alpha satisfying one universal relation on the projective bundle P of E (statement lines 7279-7296, tag 02U6). The proof proves the relation by definition for a single integral class, then reduces a general cycle to that case by passing to the disjoint union of the components, where the projective bundle and its twisting sheaf are the products of the individual ones, and transports the relation back along a proper morphism using flat pullback versus proper pushforward and the projection formula. The transport step is the substance, so the claim is H2.
